question: The 'March of Glory' book, released in March 2025, is co-authored by whom among the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**K Arumugam and Errol D’Cruz**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book titled **'March of Glory'**, which chronicles the illustrious history and journey of **Indian Hockey**, was released in **March 2025**.
 
• It is co-authored by the duo **K Arumugam** and **Errol D’Cruz**, both of whom are esteemed figures in the realm of sports documentation and journalism.
 
• **K Arumugam** is a widely recognized **hockey historian** and **writer** who has spent decades documenting the sport’s evolution in **India**.
 
• **Errol D’Cruz** is a **veteran sports journalist** with extensive experience in covering field hockey at national and international levels.
 
• The book provides a detailed narrative of **India's** achievements in the **Olympic Games** and other major international tournaments, highlighting the **golden era** and the recent resurgence of the **national sport**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **K Arumugam:**
 
 
• He is the **Founder** of the **NGO** named **Hockey Citizen Group**, which initiated the famous **'One Thousand Hockey Legs'** project to promote the game among school children.
 
• He has authored several notable books on hockey, including **'The Golden Boot'** and **'The Gulu Report'**, and maintains an extensive **database** on **Indian hockey statistics**.
 
 
 
• **Errol D’Cruz:**
 
 
• He is a **senior editor** and **sports writer** who has covered multiple **World Cups** and **Asian Games**.
 
• His writing style is known for blending **technical analysis** with the **human-interest stories** of athletes, making sports history accessible to the general public.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Book:**
 
 
• The **'March of Glory'** serves as an important **historical record** for researchers and fans, especially in the context of **India's** renewed success in the **2020 Tokyo Olympics** and the **2024 Paris Olympics**.
 
• It documents **player profiles**, **rare photographs**, and **match reports** from the **pre-Independence** era to the **modern day**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India's Hockey Legacy:** **India** has won a total of **8 Olympic Gold Medals** in field hockey, a record that remains unparalleled in the history of the **Olympic Games**.
 
• **Authorship Context:** While other authors like **Boria Majumdar** or **Gideon Haigh** are also prominent sports writers, they are associated with different works (such as cricket or general Olympic history). The specific collaboration for **'March of Glory'** is strictly between **K Arumugam** and **Errol D’Cruz**.
 
• **Year of Release:** The release in **2025** coincides with the growing interest in **Indian sports literature**, aimed at preserving the **heritage** of **Indian athletes** for the **younger generation**.
